extraction.name: Common Corpus
extraction.description: The largest open dataset for language model pre-training, containing about two trillion tokens.
extraction.license: CC-By, MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, BSD-2-Clause, CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0, Open license
extraction.creator: Pierre-Carl Langlais, Carlos Rosas Hinostroza, Mattia Nee, Catherine Amett, Pavel Chizhov, Eliot Krzystof Jones, Irène Girard, David Mach, Anastasia Stasenko, Ivan P. Yamshchikov
extraction.inLanguage: Multilingual, including English, French, German, Spanish, Latin, Italian, Polish, Greek, Portuguese, Russian
extraction.citeAs: Langlais et al. (2025). Common Corpus: The Largest Collection of Ethical Data for LLM Pre-Training.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The data in Common Corpus are either uncopyrighted or under permissible licenses and amount to about two trillion tokens. The dataset contains a wide variety of languages, ranging from the main European languages to low-resource ones rarely present in pre-training datasets; in addition, it includes a large portion of code data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Web Scraping, Web API, Document analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The open data paradox: most of the content available under free licenses or uncopyrighted is not integrated into the existing pretraining datasets.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The data assembled in Common Corpus are either uncopyrighted or under permissible licenses and amount to about two trillion tokens.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Data was filtered and curated using various tools and techniques, including OCR correction, toxicity detection, and PII removal.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data preprocessing involved text segmentation, OCR error detection, OCR correction, and PII removal.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations were created by human annotators using various platforms and tools.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: No specific number of annotations per item mentioned
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Machine annotation tools used include OCRonos, OCPoscope, and OCRerrcr.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Common Corpus will remain an evolving resource reflecting the need for a continuous open infrastructure rather than a fixed dataset, with HuggingFace ensuring a proper archiving of past versions for reproducibility.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) is protected and replaced with fictitious but realistic values.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset has a significant social impact by providing open and accessible data for language model training, promoting open science research and development.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset has been filtered to mitigate potential biases and harms, including toxicity detection and removal of harmful language.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is not directly suitable for task-specific fine-tuning and has limitations in terms of data generalization limits and quality issues.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for pre-training Large Language Models, creating new datasets, and training models for creative writing and historical language modeling.
